alt: Three panels of the right hip and thigh. Top: superficial anterior pelvic and thigh muscles (iliacus, psoas major, tensor fasciae latae, sartorius, rectus femoris, vastus lateralis and medialis, pectineus, adductor longus, gracilis, adductor magnus, patellar ligament). Bottom left: deep anterior view showing pectineus, obturator externus and the adductor group on the femur. Bottom right: posterior view showing gluteus maximus and medius cut to expose gluteus minimus, piriformis, superior and inferior gemelli, obturator internus and externus, quadratus femoris, and the hamstrings.
caption: Pelvic and thigh muscles that move the femur (OpenStax): superficial anterior, deep anterior and posterior (gluteal) views. The posterior panel shows the deep lateral rotators - piriformis, superior and inferior gemelli, obturator internus and externus, quadratus femoris - under the cut gluteus maximus and medius.
